scope: Pass 11 only: author-reported findings, publication independence, controls, source-reading level; no experiments by AI-Research
unit_rule: A selected line, test well, literature case, genome clone, study modeled world and separately evolved laboratory population are noninterchangeable statistical units.

papers.study_unit: ten selected descendant lines from one implanted fungal germling
papers.major_contrast: E. coli injection failure vs M. rhizoxinica selected inheritance and FACS withdrawal
papers.outcomes: Positive-spore transmission and germination improved; after withdrawal evolved symbiosis diluted below propagation threshold by 4–5 rounds; ancestral within 1
papers.negative_control: E. coli injection non-transmitted; selection withdrawal
papers.missing: Does not demonstrate spontaneous partner entry or permanent unsorted group reproduction

papers.study_unit: specified population ODE fixed points and mutant invasions; no biological cohorts
papers.outcomes: Under stipulated inhibition-reduction and costs the bound mutant can invade/replace free-living partners
papers.external_preinstallation: host mutant already binds partners; consortial reproduction and random surface symbiont sorting assumed
papers.missing: model does not demonstrate evolved attachment, vertical heritable group daughters or endogenous new primitive rules

papers.study_unit: 106 cross-literature host-bacterial pairings, 58 bacterial symbionts, 89 host species; phylogenetic non-independence
papers.outcomes: Mean host fitness loss on removal 52% vertically transmitted vs 21% horizontal in subset; more nutritional dependence
papers.missing: associations not experimental origins or direct co-transmission causation

papers.study_unit: original 4 monoculture and 4 P. putida co-culture evolutionary replicates (~200 generations) reused from earlier Rodríguez-Verdugo and Ackermann study
papers.outcomes: Two lineages stable ~150 generations in co-culture, frequency dependence hypothesis not supported by reciprocal invasion assays
papers.negative_control: monoculture vs producer-containing co-culture; starting-frequency invasion assays
papers.missing: no matched exogenous benzoate resource-flux control; no joint daughter collective evidence

papers.study_unit: experimental bacterial mono and obligate mutualistic cocultures; exact independent biological population denominators pending complete methods
papers.outcomes: cross-feeding consortia adapted less well to rising antibiotic stress and sometimes returned to autonomy
papers.missing: full main methods and per-treatment replicates not audited in AI-Research

papers.study_unit: abrupt-salinity/PNP stressed E. coli mutualist populations; exact denominators and stress-specific counts pending complete full-paper audit
papers.outcomes: >80% reported recovery but only one partner survived in every rescued mutualist population, with metabolic independence restored
papers.missing: complete variant reconstruction and per-stressor cohort counting still to audit; these are not 2022 antibiotic replicates

papers.study_unit: mathematical systems with evolving dependence/cohesion parameters, no wet-lab cohort
papers.outcomes: dependence may evolve faster than reproductive cohesion and finite collective carrying capacity limits completion
papers.missing: original equations, calibration and supplement not fully reviewed

papers.study_unit: externally given patch/resource/migration metapopulation, no wet-lab cohort
papers.outcomes: selected parameter regimes can create collective-level birth–death properties from ecological structure
papers.missing: does not establish evolved or independently reproduced patches/boundaries

critical_overlaps: Al-Tameemi 2024 is new analysis/assay of previously established 200-generation Rodríguez-Verdugo/Ackermann evolution lines, not new independent 200-generation origins
Giger 2024 ten derived selection lines share ONE inserted fungal founder, while positive spores/flow-cytometry counts are not distinct evolutionary origins
Fisher 2017 106 pairings share taxonomic histories and some host/symbiont taxa, corrected through phylogenetic modeling, not 106 independent lab origins
Krishnan 2026, Athreya 2025, Black et al 2020 are distinct modeling studies, NOT independent demonstrations of physically reproducing new individuals
Pauli 2022 and Melero-Jiménez 2025 use distinct experimental stress regimes/strain dependencies; one cannot pool their success rates as the same protocol
Study relative fitness, individual copy rate, group daughter fidelity and source-dependent morphology must be kept on separate axes
